Anthropic CEO Predicts AI Could Cure Diseases, Addresses Trust Concerns

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei predicts that artificial intelligence could eliminate most human illnesses within the next five to ten years. He stated that AI must deliver on its biggest promises to win public trust, acknowledging concerns that companies or governments might misuse the technology. Amodei also rejected claims that his own warnings about AI fueled public backlash. He believes AI's ability to cure diseases like cancer is a key way to gain public acceptance.
